items.text: It remains unclear as to what the Patria has delivered or picked up at these ports on the African continent. Read our investigation into the vessel's strange behaviour earlier this year on our website: www.bellingcat.com/news/africa/...

Experts previously told us that the Russian vessel's movements, going back and forth around the west coast of Africa, were highly unusual and may warrant scrutiny. The tanker, which is under sanctions, has previously been reported to have transported weapons.

Sanctioned Russian vessel the Patria, which has been shuttling between ports on the west coast of Africa since March this year and was last seen loitering off the coast of Lagos is on the move again. Planet satellite imagery captured the vessel at the Port of Douala, Cameroon on October 16th.
